Follow-up runs for the D9 token benchmark, which the owner approved on 2026-10-25. Results are added to `docs/benchmarks/token-benchmark.md`. **Diff note:** this branch sits on top of #867's original commits. #867 was squash-merged as df42f0f42, and its tree is byte-identical to this branch's parent, 20b4b2cf0. GitHub therefore also lists #867's files in this diff, but the only new commit is **2a98c7176**. I did not rebase because master is frozen for the 0.4.0 cut. Rebase or squash on merge after the cut. ## Headline **Fairer baseline.** The third arm uses the official github-mcp-server v2.0.3 tools, answered from recorded responses of the same snapshot. Results on Sonnet 5.5, median cost per run: | Workload | GitHub MCP | Brick | Brick vs GitHub MCP | |---|---|---|---| | W1 | $0.0541 | $0.0043 | −92% | | W2 | $0.0570 | $0.0037 | −94% | | W3 | $0.0943 | $0.0126 | −87% | Verdicts matched the reference on 15 of 15 runs. The GitHub MCP arm itself costs 49–70% less than the raw-API arm. The quotable claim drops from 96–98% to **87–94%** against the official GitHub MCP server, and `docs/marketing/claims-cheat-sheet.md` is updated to match. **Haiku 5.5** (`claude-haiku-5-5`). Brick costs 86–97% less than GitHub MCP. Verdict accuracy against the Sonnet verdicts: - Brick: 15 of 15. - GitHub MCP: 14 of 15 on a strict match. The miss wrote `microsoft/aspire`, the repo's new name, and the verdict itself was correct. **Local qwen3:4b** (Ollama, CPU only): - Brick arm: correct on W1–W3, taking 155–740 s per run. - GitHub MCP arm: ran on W1 only (754 s). The verdict was correct but named no blocker. - An 8B model was not feasible: the VM has about 5 GB of free RAM and no GPU. **Spend:** $0.86 this round ($0.80 Sonnet, $0.06 Haiku), under the $3 and $2 guards. The key was used as an env var only and has been unset. ## Changes - `tools/token-benchmark/run.py`: - a `ghmcp` arm, using the recorded `fixtures/ghmcp/` (6 tools, 50 calls) with live recording via `GHMCP_COMMAND` on a miss; - an Ollama backend; - tiered pricing; - `--reps` per arm; - a `--reference` verdict-accuracy column; - stripping of `` blocks before verdicts are parsed. - Results: `results/2026-10-25-ghmcp-sonnet/`, `results/2026-10-25-haiku/` and `results/2026-10-25-qwen3-4b-local/`. - Docs: `docs/benchmarks/token-benchmark.md` (new section "Follow-up runs"), the claims cheat sheet, the tool's README and `CHANGELOG.md`. ## Not overlapping This PR does not touch the separate accuracy test that the other fork is running. ## Testing - `scripts/ci/run-repo-gates.sh`: 41 of 41 passed. - `scripts/ci/verify-doc-anchors.py`: all anchors resolve. - The knowledge graph was regenerated and is current.
